symptom: Work Equipment Does Not Move in Single Operation
detail_of_failure: Work equipment does not move in single operation
related_information: Pre-troubleshooting If a failure code is shown, do the troubleshooting for that code first. Monitoring code • Boom RAISE PPC pressure can be examined with the monitoring function. (Code: 07400) • Arm IN PPC Pressure can be examined with the monitoring function. (Code: 07200) • Bucket CURL PPC Pressure can be examined with the monitoring function. (Code: 07300) • Bucket Dump PPC Pressure can be examined with the monitoring function. (Code: 07301)

steps.procedure: 1. Release the pressure that remains in the hydraulic tank and piping to examine. For details, see Testing and Adjusting, “Release Remained Pressure in Hydraulic Circuit”. 2. Examine the control valve body and the boom spool to see if they are not twisted or stuck and that they do not have any damage or dirt on them. (They must move smoothly and not be stuck.) REMARK Be careful that dirt does not enter during recovery work.

branches.YES: • Boom control valve body and spool are normal. • Go to the next check item.
branches.NO: • Boom control valve body and spool are defective. • Repair or replace the boom control valve body and spool. • Go to “Confirmation of repair”.

steps.procedure: 1. Release the pressure that remains in the hydraulic tank and piping to examine. For details, see Testing and Adjusting, “Release Remained Pressure in Hydraulic Circuit”. 2. Are the control valve body and the arm spool clean, with no twisting, seizure, scratches, or dirt? (They must move smoothly and not be stuck.) REMARK Be careful that dirt does not enter during recovery work.

branches.YES: • Arm control valve body and spool are normal. • Go to the next check item.
branches.NO: • Arm control valve body and spool are defective. • Repair or replace the arm control valve body and spool. • Go to “Confirmation of repair”.

steps.procedure: 1. Stop the engine. 2. Connect all the component parts. 3. Start the engine. 4. Operate the lever to do the troubleshooting. 5. Does each work equipment operate normally?

branches.NO: Go back to the first check item.
